391-1671-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-1671-2645-3430.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-3585-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

618-1938-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-1938-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Mana Dork That Adds at Least {G}

215-3430--85--200.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding three times the usual amount of mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the mana-producing creature from the battlefield to your hand and giving Temur Sabertooth indestructible until end of turn.
Cast the mana-producing creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat any number of times.
If the loop produces infinite mana (see Notes), you can then spend that mana to activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times, returning and recasting any creatures you control whose costs can be paid for by the type of mana you have.
215-3430--85--200.notes: A mana dork that costs one to play and taps to add one (before modifiers) will break even, allowing you to perform this infinite loop without the infinite mana or infinite blinking results. Most mana dorks that tap for more than one mana will provide those additional results.

1349-5239-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-5239-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

553-1470-4838.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Najal.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-3480.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-7296.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1263-4871-6797-7316.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1494-6822-7178-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2438-7084-7396.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

145-943-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
145-943-4235.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Serra's Sanctum.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Serra's Sanctum
Repeat
145-943-4235.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Serra's Sanctum.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1020-2034-2866-3771.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5295-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

343-2366-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-5205-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2034-2932-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2034-2932-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2034-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

24-1640-5759.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-1640-5759.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

500-1181-2239.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ardent Elementalist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Ardent Elementalist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Ardent Elementalist token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

1021-2167-4050-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-2167-4050-6761.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
If you control three or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control two Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-2167-4050-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {1}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least three at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control four or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

562-2512-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Warrior en-Kor ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

1247-3717-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Viridian Joiner and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-3717-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Viridian Joiner's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3200-4708-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
3200-4708-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

3982-4377-5003.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Living Lore.
Living Lore does not have summoning sickness.
3982-4377-5003.description:
Deal combat damage to a player or permanent using Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Living Lore dies, its reflexive ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Living Lore trigger, causing you to cast Walk the Aeons from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Living Lore from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
As Living Lore enters the battlefield, choose to exile Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

3492-3609-5740.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-5740.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin you control.
Layla triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

4365-5361-5521.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Captain's Claws attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
4365-5361-5521.description:
Declare Auton Soldier and the creature with Captain's Claws as attackers.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Captain's Claws trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Mondrak attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Captain's Claws trigger, creating 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) 1/1 Kor Ally creature tokens tapped and attacking an opponent.

985-2350-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3398-3920-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Valduk has at least seven Auras and/or Equipments attached to it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-3920-5231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least seven 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with trample and haste.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability seven times by sacrificing seven Elementals, adding seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Valduk has at least eight Auras and/or Equipments attached to it, this combo nets infinite Elemental tokens and colored mana.

4166-4490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an opponent to lose exactly 1 life.
4166-4490.description:
Cause an opponent to lose 1 life.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and exiling the top card of your library.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

824-2265-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
824-2265-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature, and putting two +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control.
Repeat.

245-2034-2713.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {4}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Astartes Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

751-2060-2445-2854.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-2060-2445-2854.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-1993-3861.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-1993-3861.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

618-821-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mogg Fanatic with haste.
Activate the Mogg Fanatic token by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Kiki-Jiki's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1495-1656-2265-4038-4929.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1495-1656-2265-4038-4929.description:
Pay {1} and tap Necrotic Ooze using the Trilobite's ability to put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Hardened Scales doubles this.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counters from Necrotic Ooze using the Trilobite's ability to generate {4} for activated abilities.
Pay {2} and untap Necrotic Ooze using Farmstead Gleaner's ability and put 2 +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze.
You have {2} floating and Necrotic Ooze with 2 counters.
Repeat to generate infinite {C} for activated abilities, and Necrotic Ooze having infinite +1/+1 counters Remove counters from Necrotic Ooze using Triskelion's ability to ping an opponent.
Repeat to ping your opponent to death.

3972-4221.description: Living Plane makes all lands 1/1 creatures, and Ethereal Absolution gives opponent creatures -1/-1.
